text_block_list.text:
The days flew by in an instant, bringing the New Year.
While the students were enjoying their winter break—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Here you go, salt ramen order up!
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.text: I ducked into a ramen shop that was open on New Year's Day and set to work revising our training menu.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, is Fu's Trainer working through a meal on New Year's?
choice_data_list: Yes, it's because she's in the Classic class starting this year.

text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown—the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho—that Ines Fuujin is challenging is a once-in-a-lifetime stage.

Formidable rivals will gather in every race.
If she wants to win there,
it's not just her who needs to put in the effort...
choice_data_list: Because we promised we'd run the three-legged race together!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here's an extra egg on the house.
Get some nutrition in you and go pay a visit to Fuu, too!

After getting a tip from the ramen shop owner,
I headed to the shrine, and there she was.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year~
The two rows to the right of the center are open, so everyone—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: I heard you were working part-time here, so...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Were you hoping to see me in a shrine maiden outfit?
Too bad~! Today's gig is crowd control!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Why did you come to see me?
Going out of your way to come to my part-time job and all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Is it an emergency?
Or is it—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "...Did you come to convince me because you think the time spent on a part-time job is a waste?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's such a waste!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaah.
Aha... I knew it—"
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can apply what I do at my part-time job to my training!?

text_block_list.text:
Pulling out the materials, I explained the training regimen
I had been thinking about since the end of the year.

"Lately, the late-kick speed of the closers in our year has gotten
even sharper. As a front-runner, I want to avoid a race development
that lets opponents like that conserve their energy."

"That is why I want her to become an Umamusume
who can control her own pace during a race. Yes, for example—"
choice_data_list: Like being able to control the entire flow of the crowd of worshipers!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~?
choice_data_list: ...Is it a bit too much after all?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I kind of feel like what we just talked about
doesn't really connect to managing the shrine visitors.
choice_data_list: I see~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's right~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. But yeah, I get it.
"Applying what I do at work to training," huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Just a thought, but
since you were so pumped up about it...
did you have another plan in mind?"
choice_data_list: I'll try anything I can to boost my speed!
I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
I'm thinking about starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
Stay aware of your positioning while posting!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Just a thought, but
since you were so pumped up about it...
did you have another plan in mind?"
choice_data_list: I'll try anything I can to boost my speed!
I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
I'm thinking about starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
Stay aware of your positioning while posting!

text_block_list.text: There are multiple factors that drive speed besides building muscle.

"Things like lightening the shoes, or dental maintenance
to make it easier to clench teeth
while running..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So you want to try it all from scratch.
choice_data_list: Right!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~. I have so much to do starting
tomorrow, it's gonna be rough~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What?!
You're starting a part-time job?!
choice_data_list: It's just a receptionist part-time job, but...

text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if we hit it off with the clinic's doctor,
we might be able to request house-call treatments
after training or before races."

Lately, her back muscles have seemed rather tight.
If there is any way to ease that strain, even a little...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...What an idiot.
choice_data_list: I'm pretty serious about this!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Then let me say this.
If you're that worried,
you should just lock in a clinic appointment schedule."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you'd told me beforehand, I could've just adjusted
my shifts. Wouldn't that be way easier
than you taking up a part-time job, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...You really are a worrywart
who always puts me first."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Isn't that a great idea?
Let's try it out first thing tomorrow morning!
choice_data_list: Right?!
Right!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha.
You're way too excited.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, crouch down right there.
Your shoelaces are untied.
choice_data_list: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Liiie.
At that moment, two gentle pats landed warmly on my head.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I put a lot of thought into it!
So that gets a gold star! Good girl, good girl!”
choice_data_list: Um, this is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Just a token of appreciation.
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you know your ideas...
All of them assume that I'm gonna work a part-time job.
choice_data_list: Because I made a promise to you.
Because I made a vow to you

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: For me?
choice_data_list: If it's precious to you, I want to treasure it too.
If it's precious to you, I want to cherish it too.

text_block_list.text:
"...She loves running.
But she loves her family just as much."

If part-time work means 'taking action
for the sake of my younger sisters' to her, then restricting it—
choice_data_list: I love seeing you run so happily.
I love how you look when you run so happily.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Running like you're having fun, huh?
Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I'll be even more selfish!
Once my Triple Crown challenge is over,
I might ask to run in an even more amazing race♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Without quitting any of my part-time jobs either.
I'd even say I don't want to let go of anything.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Will you still love me even after that?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll definitely support you!
Yeah, I'll definitely support you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Confession was a huuuuge success!
I was waiting for you to say that. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's have a great year together!
Trainer!!"
